characters.name: Gladias
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Veridia thread; a Keeper in the Order of Steering, husband of Seila, father of Zven and Lily. Thoughtful, earnest, calm and curious; in these chapters more confident and argumentative (pitches the court case to the judges), tender with his family. Occasionally speaks slow, careful Dzegoban.

characters.name: Seila
characters.voice_notes: Gladias's wife, blogger on economics and culture, mother of Zven and Lily. Sharp, warm, direct; the strategist behind the Silverchat poll (ch27); loving and protective with her children; calls Gladias 'Glad'.

characters.name: Evelor
characters.voice_notes: Founder of Silverchat. Bluntly honest, intellectually curious, technically sharp (cryptography, AI, eigenvectors); friendly, informal host who enjoys a debate.

characters.name: Zei
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Dzego thread; national Minpentai champion and gifted cryptographer, now supervising drone combat for the Kungaupei and Veridia. Quick, precise, fluent technical explainer; playful with friends; tense, despairing and then elated during the battles (ch26, ch29-30). Occasionally speaks Dzegoban.

characters.name: Den
characters.voice_notes: High Council member of the Kungaupei (Dzego's shadow defence organisation), Zei's mentor and mission commander. Composed, authoritative, dry and blunt; leads Group South and is killed in ch29 (his ch30 line is a remembered quote).

characters.name: Mu
characters.age: older adult (described earlier as an older woman)
characters.voice_notes: Kungaupei member and former Minpentai tournament organiser, a mentor figure to Zei and Bai. Calm, soft-spoken, quietly brilliant improviser who stays cool in a crisis; gentle, with wry humour.

characters.name: Bai
characters.voice_notes: Minpentai player, formerly Zei's rival, now his close and affectionate ally. Confident, socially astute, a persuasive negotiator (ch28); steady and supportive under pressure (ch29); teasing humour.

characters.name: Verdow
characters.age: adult (senator, middle-aged or older; has a daughter)
characters.voice_notes: Senator Verdow: warm, jovial, quick to laugh, internationally minded; the senator Gladias trusts. Gives long reflective, philosophical speeches (law in ch25, society and the future in ch32).

characters.name: group (countdown chant)
characters.voice_notes: Gladias, Seila, Zei, Bai, Verdow, Den and Mu chanting the last ten ticks of a Dzegoban countdown together in a mock announcer voice; one N-coded line.

notes: No lettered exceptions. S is Seila throughout (the judge Sewlert from ch26 does not appear); E is Evelor throughout (Emerald is only mentioned). 27:31 is Seila whispering through her neck band. 27:55 is Evelor reading a poll question aloud. 27:108 (Zei) and 27:110 (Bai) are Dzegoban countdown phrases in a mock robotic announcer voice. NARRATOR EXCEPTION: 27:114 is an N-coded line in quote marks - the whole group around the table chanting a Dzegoban countdown in unison; listed under narrator_exceptions as 'group (countdown chant)' (drop it if you prefer the narrator to read it). 27:143 is N-coded on-screen text: the written executive summary from the first forecaster bot (an AI, written only, not spoken) - left to the narrator, but you may want a synthetic 'forecaster bot' voice for its six runs. All lettered attributions confident.
